sanskrit: rājñāṃ tu pratipūjārthaṃ saṃjayaṃ saṃnyayojayat kṛtākṛtaparijñāne bhīṣmadroṇau mahāmatī
english: For the purpose of honoring the kings, he appointed Sanjaya; and the two great-minded ones, Bhishma and Drona, he appointed for discerning what had been done and what remained undone.

sanskrit: hiraṇyasya suvarṇasya ratnānāṃ cānvavekṣaṇe dakṣiṇānāṃ ca vai dāne kṛpaṃ rājā nyayojayat tathānyān puruṣavyāghrāṃs tasmiṃs tasmin nyayojayat
english: The king appointed Kripa for the superintendence of gold, silver, and gems, and for the distribution of sacrificial fees; and likewise he appointed other tiger-like men in their respective stations.

sanskrit: bāhliko dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca somadatto jayadrathaḥ nakulena samānītāḥ svāmivat tatra remire
english: Bahlika, Dhritarashtra, Somadatta, and Jayadratha, brought there by Nakula, took their ease as though they were masters of the house.

sanskrit: kṣattā vyayakaras tv āsīd viduraḥ sarvadharmavit duryodhanas tv arhaṇāni pratijagrāha sarvaśaḥ
english: Vidura the steward, knower of all dharma, was the disbursing officer; while Duryodhana received all the tribute-offerings on every side.

sanskrit: sarvalokaḥ samāvṛttaḥ piprīṣuḥ phalam uttamam draṣṭukāmaḥ sabhāṃ caiva dharmarājaṃ ca pāṇḍavam
english: All the world came together, eager to obtain the highest reward and desirous of beholding the assembly hall as well as Yudhishthira the Pandava, the dharma-king.

sanskrit: na kaś cid āharat tatra sahasrāvaram arhaṇam ratnaiś ca bahubhis tatra dharmarājam avardhayan
english: No one brought a tribute-gift worth less than a thousand; and there they magnified the dharma-king with many precious jewels.

sanskrit: kathaṃ nu mama kauravyo ratnadānaiḥ samāpnuyāt yajñam ity eva rājānaḥ spardhamānā dadur dhanam
english: "How shall the son of the Kuru house complete this sacrifice with my gift of gems?" — with this rivalry in mind, the kings lavished wealth upon him.

sanskrit: bhavanaiḥ savimānāgraiḥ sodarkair balasaṃvṛtaiḥ lokarājavimānaiś ca brāhmaṇāvasathaiḥ saha
english: With palaces topped by aerial towers, attended by retinues and guarded by troops, together with the celestial chariots of the world-kings and the dwelling-places of brahmanas —

sanskrit: kṛtair āvasathair divyair vimānapratimais tathā vicitrai ratnavadbhiś ca ṛddhyā paramayā yutaiḥ
english: — with divine residences that had been constructed, resembling aerial palaces, variegated and adorned with gems, and endowed with supreme prosperity —

sanskrit: rājabhiś ca samāvṛttair atīvaśrīsamṛddhibhiḥ aśobhata sado rājan kaunteyasya mahātmanaḥ
english: — and surrounded by kings possessed of extraordinary splendor and wealth, the assembly hall of the great-souled son of Kunti shone resplendently, O king.

sanskrit: ṛddhyā ca varuṇaṃ devaṃ spardhamāno yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ṣaḍagninātha yajñena so 'yajad dakṣiṇāvatā sarvāñ janān sarvakāmaiḥ samṛddhaiḥ samatarpayat
english: Competing in prosperity with the god Varuna himself, Yudhishthira worshipped with the six-fire sacrifice endowed with generous fees, and he satisfied all people with every desire abundantly fulfilled.

sanskrit: annavān bahubhakṣyaś ca bhuktavajjanasaṃvṛtaḥ ratnopahārakarmaṇyo babhūva sa samāgamaḥ
english: That grand assembly was abundantly supplied with food and many kinds of eatables, thronged with people who had eaten their fill, and was characterized by the reception of jeweled tribute-offerings.

sanskrit: iḍājyahomāhutibhir mantraśikṣāsamanvitaiḥ tasmin hi tatṛpur devās tate yajñe maharṣibhiḥ
english: At that sacrifice, spread out and accompanied by the great sages, the gods were truly satisfied by the oblations of sacrificial cake, clarified butter, and burnt offerings, performed with proper mantra-recitation.

sanskrit: yathā devās tathā viprā dakṣiṇānnamahādhanaiḥ tatṛpuḥ sarvavarṇāś ca tasmin yajñe mudānvitāḥ
english: Just as the gods were satisfied, so too the brahmanas were satisfied with generous fees, food, and great wealth; and all the varnas were joyfully contented at that sacrifice.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tato 'bhiṣecanīye 'hni brāhmaṇā rājabhiḥ saha antarvedīṃ praviviśuḥ satkārārthaṃ maharṣayaḥ
english: Vaishampayana said: Then, on the day of the royal consecration, brahmanas, together with kings, and great sages entered the inner sacrificial enclosure for the purpose of the honor ceremony.

sanskrit: nāradapramukhās tasyām antarvedyāṃ mahātmanaḥ samāsīnāḥ śuśubhire saha rājarṣibhis tadā
english: Headed by Narada, the great-souled ones, seated in that inner enclosure together with the royal sages, shone with splendor at that time.

sanskrit: sametā brahmabhavane devā devarṣayo yathā karmāntaram upāsanto jajalpur amitaujasaḥ
english: Assembled as though in the hall of Brahma, those of immeasurable might — like gods and divine sages — awaited the next rite and engaged in pleasant conversation.

sanskrit: idam evaṃ na cāpy evam evam etan na cānyathā ity ūcur bahavas tatra vitaṇḍānāḥ parasparam
english: "It is thus and not otherwise," "this is so and not different" — many there debated contentiously with one another in that fashion.

sanskrit: kṛśān arthāṃs tathā ke cid akṛśāṃs tatra kurvate akṛśāṃś ca kṛśāṃś cakrur hetubhiḥ śāstraniścitaiḥ
english: There some made light arguments appear weighty, while others, through reasoning established by scripture, made the weighty appear light.

sanskrit: tatra medhāvinaḥ ke cid artham anyaiḥ prapūritam vicikṣipur yathā śyenā nabhogatam ivāmiṣam
english: There some sharp-witted men, like hawks swooping at meat in the sky, snatched at a point that others had fully developed.

sanskrit: ke cid dharmārthasaṃyuktāḥ kathās tatra mahāvratāḥ remire kathayantaś ca sarvavedavidāṃ varāḥ
english: Others, devoted to their great vows, occupied themselves in discussions joined with dharma and artha; the best among those who know all the Vedas delighted in narrating them.

sanskrit: sā vedir vedasaṃpannair devadvijamaharṣibhiḥ ābabhāse samākīrṇā nakṣatrair dyaur ivāmalā
english: That sacrificial enclosure, crowded with gods, twice-born sages, and great seers conversant with the Vedas, shone like a clear sky studded with stars.

sanskrit: na tasyāṃ saṃnidhau śūdraḥ kaś cid āsīn na cāvrataḥ antarvedyāṃ tadā rājan yudhiṣṭhiraniveśane
english: In that inner enclosure of Yudhishthira's sacrificial ground, O king, there was present at that time neither any shudra nor anyone who had not undertaken a religious vow.

sanskrit: tāṃ tu lakṣmīvato lakṣmīṃ tadā yajñavidhānajām tutoṣa nāradaḥ paśyan dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ
english: Narada, beholding that prosperity born of the sacrificial ordinance of the prosperous dharma-king, the wise one, was delighted.

sanskrit: atha cintāṃ samāpede sa munir manujādhipa nāradas taṃ tadā paśyan sarvakṣatrasamāgamam
english: Then, O lord of men, the sage Narada fell into deep thought as he beheld that gathering of all the kshatriyas.

sanskrit: sasmāra ca purāvṛttāṃ kathāṃ tāṃ bharatarṣabha aṃśāvataraṇe yāsau brahmaṇo bhavane 'bhavat
english: And he recalled, O bull of the Bharatas, that ancient discourse which had taken place in Brahma's hall concerning the descent of the divine portions.

sanskrit: devānāṃ saṃgamaṃ taṃ tu vijñāya kurunandana nāradaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ sasmāra manasā harim
english: Recognizing in that assembly of kings a gathering of the gods, O joy of the Kurus, Narada remembered in his mind Hari, the lotus-eyed one.

sanskrit: sākṣāt sa vibudhārighnaḥ kṣatre nārāyaṇo vibhuḥ pratijñāṃ pālayan dhīmāñ jātaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ
english: He, Narayana the all-pervading, the slayer of the enemies of the gods, the wise one, conqueror of enemy cities, was born in person among the kshatriyas, fulfilling his promise.

sanskrit: saṃdideśa purā yo 'sau vibudhān bhūtakṛt svayam anyonyam abhinighnantaḥ punar lokān avāpsyatha
english: He who is the creator of all beings himself commanded the gods of old: "Slaying one another, you shall regain your respective worlds."

sanskrit: iti nārāyaṇaḥ śaṃbhuḥ bhagavāñ jagataḥ prabhuḥ ādiśya vibudhān sarvān ajāyata yadukṣaye
english: Having thus commanded all the gods, Narayana the auspicious, the blessed Lord, the master of the universe, was born at the end of the Yadu line.

sanskrit: kṣitāv andhakavṛṣṇīnāṃ vaṃśe vaṃśabhṛtāṃ varaḥ parayā śuśubhe lakṣmyā nakṣatrāṇām ivoḍurāṭ
english: On earth, as the best of those who uphold the lineage, born in the line of the Andhakas and Vrishnis, he shone with supreme splendor like the moon among the stars.

sanskrit: yasya bāhubalaṃ sendrāḥ surāḥ sarva upāsate so 'yaṃ mānuṣavan nāma harir āste 'rimardanaḥ
english: He whose might of arm all the gods, including Indra, serve and revere — that Hari, the crusher of foes, dwells here, appearing as though a mere human.

sanskrit: aho bata mahad bhūtaṃ svayaṃbhūr yad idaṃ svayam ādāsyati punaḥ kṣatram evaṃ balasamanvitam
english: "Ah, how great a wonder that the Self-Existent One himself will restore the kshatriya order, thus endowed with power, once again" — so Narada reflected.

sanskrit: ity etāṃ nāradaś cintāṃ cintayām āsa dharmavit hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ jñātvā yajñair īḍyaṃ tam īśvaram
english: Thus did Narada, knower of dharma, turn this thought over in his mind, knowing Hari Narayana to be the Lord worthy of worship with sacrifices.

sanskrit: tasmin dharmavidāṃ śreṣṭho dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ mahādhvare mahābuddhis tasthau sa bahumānataḥ
english: At that great sacrifice of the wise dharma-king, Narada — the best among those who know dharma, himself of great wisdom — stood there with deep reverence.

sanskrit: tato bhīṣmo 'bravīd rājan dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram kriyatām arhaṇaṃ rājñāṃ yathārham iti bhārata
english: Then Bhishma, O king, spoke to Yudhishthira the dharma-king: "Let the honor-offering to the kings be made as is fitting, O descendant of Bharata."

sanskrit: ācāryam ṛtvijaṃ caiva saṃyuktaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira snātakaṃ ca priyaṃ cāhuḥ ṣaḍ arghyārhān nṛpaṃ tathā
english: "A teacher, a sacrificial priest, an allied king, O Yudhishthira, a graduate in vedic study, a dear friend, and a king — these six are said to be worthy of the arghya honor-offering."

sanskrit: etān arhān abhigatān āhuḥ saṃvatsaroṣitān ta ime kālapūgasya mahato 'smān upāgatāḥ
english: "These worthy ones, who have arrived after residing elsewhere for a year or more — those are said to be deserving of the arghya; and these have come to us after a long period of time."

sanskrit: eṣām ekaikaśo rājann arghyam ānīyatām iti atha caiṣāṃ variṣṭhāya samarthāyopanīyatām
english: "Let the arghya be brought for each of them one by one, O king" — and moreover, "Let it be presented first to the most eminent and most worthy among them."

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kasmai bhavān manyate 'rgham ekasmai kurunandana upanīyamānaṃ yuktaṃ ca tan me brūhi pitāmaha
english: Yudhishthira said: "To which one, O joy of the Kurus, do you think it proper that the arghya be first presented? Tell me that, O grandsire."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tato bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavo buddhyā niścitya bhārata vārṣṇeyaṃ manyate kṛṣṇam arhaṇīyatamaṃ bhuvi
english: Vaishampayana said: Then Bhishma, son of Shantanu, having resolved with his intellect, O descendant of Bharata, considered Krishna of the Vrishni clan to be the most deserving of honor on earth.

sanskrit: eṣa hy eṣāṃ sametānāṃ tejobalaparākramaiḥ madhye tapann ivābhāti jyotiṣām iva bhāskaraḥ
english: "For this one shines in the midst of all those assembled, with energy, strength, and valor, blazing like the sun amid the heavenly lights."

sanskrit: asūryam iva sūryeṇa nivātam iva vāyunā bhāsitaṃ hlāditaṃ caiva kṛṣṇenedaṃ sado hi naḥ
english: "Like a sunless place illumined by the sun, like a windless place refreshed by the wind — so our assembly is illumined and gladdened by Krishna."

sanskrit: tasmai bhīṣmābhyanujñātaḥ sahadevaḥ pratāpavān upajahre 'tha vidhivad vārṣṇeyāyārghyam uttamam
english: Authorized by Bhishma, the valiant Sahadeva then presented, according to proper rite, the most excellent arghya to the scion of the Vrishnis.

sanskrit: pratijagrāha tat kṛṣṇaḥ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā śiśupālas tu tāṃ pūjāṃ vāsudeve na cakṣame
english: Krishna accepted it with the ceremony prescribed by scripture; but Shishupala could not bear that act of worship being rendered to Vasudeva.

sanskrit: sa upālabhya bhīṣmaṃ ca dharmarājaṃ ca saṃsadi apākṣipad vāsudevaṃ cedirājo mahābalaḥ
english: Reviling both Bhishma and the dharma-king in the assembly, the mighty king of the Chedi country heaped abuse upon Vasudeva.

sanskrit: śiśupāla uvāca nāyam arhati vārṣṇeyas tiṣṭhatsv iha mahātmasu mahīpatiṣu kauravya rājavat pārthivārhaṇam
english: Shishupala said: "This Vrishni does not deserve royal honor-worship when so many great-souled lords of the earth are present here, O Kauravya."

sanskrit: nāyaṃ yuktaḥ samācāraḥ pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu yat kāmāt puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ pāṇḍavārcitavān asi
english: "This conduct is not proper among the great-souled Pandavas — that out of favoritism you have caused the lotus-eyed one to be worshipped by a Pandava."

sanskrit: bālā yūyaṃ na jānīdhvaṃ dharmaḥ sūkṣmo hi pāṇḍavāḥ ayaṃ tatrābhyatikrānta āpageyo 'lpadarśanaḥ
english: "You are children who do not understand — dharma is subtle, O Pandavas. This son of the river-goddess has transgressed in that matter, being of limited vision."

sanskrit: tvādṛśo dharmayukto hi kurvāṇaḥ priyakāmyayā bhavaty abhyadhikaṃ bhīṣmo lokeṣv avamataḥ satām
english: "Indeed, one such as Bhishma, endowed with dharma, yet acting out of mere favoritism, becomes all the more despised in the worlds among the righteous."

sanskrit: kathaṃ hy arājā dāśārho madhye sarvamahīkṣitām arhaṇām arhati tathā yathā yuṣmābhir arcitaḥ
english: "How does this Dasharha who is not a king deserve the kind of honor-worship with which you have worshipped him, in the presence of all lords of the earth?"

sanskrit: atha vā manyase kṛṣṇaṃ sthaviraṃ bharatarṣabha vasudeve sthite vṛddhe katham arhati tatsutaḥ
english: "Or perhaps you consider Krishna to be an elder, O bull of the Bharatas? But while his father Vasudeva, who is truly aged, still lives, how can his son deserve it?"

sanskrit: atha vā vāsudevo 'pi priyakāmo 'nuvṛttavān drupade tiṣṭhati kathaṃ mādhavo 'rhati pūjanam
english: "Or perhaps, even Vasudeva himself, acting out of desire to please, has followed Drupada's wishes — and in that case, how does this Madhava deserve worship?"

sanskrit: ācāryaṃ manyase kṛṣṇam atha vā kurupuṃgava droṇe tiṣṭhati vārṣṇeyaṃ kasmād arcitavān asi
english: "Do you consider Krishna your teacher, O bull of the Kurus? But while Drona still lives, why have you worshipped this Vrishni scion?"

sanskrit: ṛtvijaṃ manyase kṛṣṇam atha vā kurunandana dvaipāyane sthite vipre kathaṃ kṛṣṇo 'rcitas tvayā
english: "Do you consider Krishna your sacrificial priest, O joy of the Kurus? But while the brahmin Dvaipayana still lives, how did you worship Krishna?"

sanskrit: naiva ṛtviṅ na cācāryo na rājā madhusūdanaḥ arcitaś ca kuruśreṣṭha kim anyat priyakāmyayā
english: "Madhusudana is neither a sacrificial priest, nor a teacher, nor a king — yet he has been worshipped, O best of Kurus. What other reason can there be but favoritism?"

sanskrit: atha vāpy arcanīyo 'yaṃ yuṣmākaṃ madhusūdanaḥ kiṃ rājabhir ihānītair avamānāya bhārata
english: "Or if this Madhusudana is to be worshipped by you, then why, O descendant of Bharata, were the kings brought here — merely to be dishonored?"

sanskrit: vayaṃ tu na bhayād asya kaunteyasya mahātmanaḥ prayacchāmaḥ karān sarve na lobhān na ca sāntvanāt
english: "We all do not pay tribute to this great-souled son of Kunti out of fear, nor out of greed, nor because we were appeased by him."

sanskrit: asya dharmapravṛttasya pārthivatvaṃ cikīrṣataḥ karān asmai prayacchāmaḥ so 'yam asmān na manyate
english: "We pay tribute to him who is devoted to dharma and who seeks to establish sovereign rule — yet he, this one, holds us in no regard."

sanskrit: kim anyad avamānād dhi yad imaṃ rājasaṃsadi aprāptalakṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇam arghyeṇārcitavān asi
english: "What other name can one give to this but dishonor — that in this royal assembly you have worshipped Krishna with the arghya, one who has not attained the mark of kingship?"

sanskrit: akasmād dharmaputrasya dharmātmeti yaśo gatam ko hi dharmacyute pūjām evaṃ yuktāṃ prayojayet yo 'yaṃ vṛṣṇikule jāto rājānaṃ hatavān purā
english: "Without cause has the fame gone forth that Dharma's son is a righteous soul — for who would offer such fitting worship to one who has fallen from dharma, this one born in the Vrishni clan who formerly slew a king?"

sanskrit: adya dharmātmatā caiva vyapakṛṣṭā yudhiṣṭhirāt kṛpaṇatvaṃ niviṣṭaṃ ca kṛṣṇe 'rghyasya nivedanāt
english: "Today Yudhishthira's reputation for righteousness has been stripped away, and wretchedness has entered into him, through the presentation of the arghya to Krishna."

sanskrit: yadi bhītāś ca kaunteyāḥ kṛpaṇāś ca tapasvinaḥ nanu tvayāpi boddhavyaṃ yāṃ pūjāṃ mādhavo 'rhati
english: "If the sons of Kunti are afraid and wretched ascetics, surely even you should understand what worship Madhava truly deserves."

sanskrit: atha vā kṛpaṇair etām upanītāṃ janārdana pūjām anarhaḥ kasmāt tvam abhyanujñātavān asi
english: "Or, O Janardana — you who are unworthy — why did you accept this worship that was offered by these wretches?"

sanskrit: ayuktām ātmanaḥ pūjāṃ tvaṃ punar bahu manyase haviṣaḥ prāpya niṣyandaṃ prāśituṃ śveva nirjane
english: "And you, moreover, think highly of this worship that is not appropriate to yourself — like a dog licking up the drippings of an oblation in a deserted place."

sanskrit: na tv ayaṃ pārthivendrāṇām avamānaḥ prayujyate tvām eva kuravo vyaktaṃ pralambhante janārdana
english: "But this dishonor is not being directed at the lords of the earth — clearly, O Janardana, it is you whom the Kauravas are deceiving."

sanskrit: klībe dārakriyā yādṛg andhe vā rūpadarśanam arājño rājavat pūjā tathā te madhusūdana
english: "As meaningless as the marriage ceremony performed for an impotent man, or as showing forms to a blind man — so is the royal worship offered to you, O Madhusudana, who are no king."

sanskrit: dṛṣṭo yudhiṣṭhiro rājā dṛṣṭo bhīṣmaś ca yādṛśaḥ vāsudevo 'py ayaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ sarvam etad yathātatham
english: "I have now seen King Yudhishthira for what he is, and I have seen Bhishma for what he is, and this Vasudeva has also been seen — all this is now exactly as it truly is."

sanskrit: ity uktvā śiśupālas tān utthāya paramāsanāt niryayau sadasas tasmāt sahito rājabhis tadā
english: Having spoken thus to them, Shishupala rose from his high seat and departed from that assembly, accompanied by the kings.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā śiśupālam upādravat uvāca cainaṃ madhuraṃ sāntvapūrvam idaṃ vacaḥ
english: Vaishampayana said: Then King Yudhishthira hastened after Shishupala and spoke these sweet, conciliatory words to him.

sanskrit: nedaṃ yuktaṃ mahīpāla yādṛśaṃ vai tvam uktavān adharmaś ca paro rājan pāruṣyaṃ ca nirarthakam
english: "This is not proper, O lord of the earth, what you have said; it is the highest adharma, O king — this harshness that serves no purpose."

sanskrit: na hi dharmaṃ paraṃ jātu nāvabudhyeta pārthiva bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavas tv enaṃ māvamaṃsthā ato 'nyathā
english: "For Bhishma son of Shantanu would never be ignorant of the highest dharma, O earth-lord — do not think otherwise; do not slight him."

sanskrit: paśya cemān mahīpālāṃs tvatto vṛddhatamān bahūn mṛṣyante cārhaṇāṃ kṛṣṇe tadvat tvaṃ kṣantum arhasi
english: "Look at these many lords of the earth, far older than you — they accept the honor-offering given to Krishna; in like manner you too ought to be patient."

sanskrit: veda tattvena kṛṣṇaṃ hi bhīṣmaś cedipate bhṛśam na hy enaṃ tvaṃ tathā vettha yathainaṃ veda kauravaḥ
english: "For Bhishma knows Krishna in truth and deeply, O lord of the Chedi; you do not know him as the Kaurava elder knows him."

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca nāsmā anunayo deyo nāyam arhati sāntvanam lokavṛddhatame kṛṣṇe yo 'rhaṇāṃ nānumanyate
english: Bhishma said: "To him no conciliation is to be given; this one does not deserve to be appeased — the one who does not approve of the honor rendered to Krishna, the eldest in the world."

sanskrit: kṣatriyaḥ kṣatriyaṃ jitvā raṇe raṇakṛtāṃ varaḥ yo muñcati vaśe kṛtvā gurur bhavati tasya saḥ
english: "The kshatriya who, having conquered another kshatriya in battle — best of those who wage battle — sets him free after bringing him under control, becomes like a guru to him."

sanskrit: asyāṃ ca samitau rājñām ekam apy ajitaṃ yudhi na paśyāmi mahīpālaṃ sātvatīputratejasā
english: "And in this assembly of kings, I do not see a single lord of the earth who has not been conquered in battle by the might of the son of the Satvata woman — Krishna."

sanskrit: na hi kevalam asmākam ayam arcyatamo 'cyutaḥ trayāṇām api lokānām arcanīyo janārdanaḥ
english: "For Achyuta — the imperishable one — is not only the most worthy of worship for us alone; Janardana is worthy of worship in all three worlds."

sanskrit: kṛṣṇena hi jitā yuddhe bahavaḥ kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ jagat sarvaṃ ca vārṣṇeye nikhilena pratiṣṭhitam
english: "For by Krishna in battle have many bull-like kshatriyas been conquered, and the entire world rests wholly in this scion of the Vrishnis."

sanskrit: tasmāt satsv api vṛddheṣu kṛṣṇam arcāma netarān evaṃ vaktuṃ na cārhas tvaṃ mā bhūt te buddhir īdṛśī
english: "Therefore, even in the presence of elders who are great, we worship Krishna and no other. You have no right to speak thus — let not your mind dwell in such a disposition."
